rules.justification: Solid mechanics model, interpolation, dumps and energies (docs/NUMERICAL_VALIDATION.md, 'Solid mechanics model'): every case of fixtures/model/smm2 is produced by oracle/probes/smm2/smm2_probe.cc with the Eigen sparse solver (bit-identical MPL-2.0 translation) and Eigen's cache sizes pinned (D-050, the port's fixed 16 KiB blocking); the strict oracle does not vectorise Eigen (-DEIGEN_DONT_VECTORIZE, -ffp-contract=off). Every compared quantity is an input fed unchanged to the port (mesh, material file, initial velocity and stress fields from the same operation order), the output of computations whose order the port replicates (FE kernels, elemental-field interpolation products through the GEBP translation, model assembly, explicit/static solves, energy sums in upstream accumulation order), or the bytes of the dump files (correctly rounded formatting, base64 of the same bits). Bit identity (byte identity for files) is the expected result; any difference is a defect.
rules.evidence: crates/akantu-solid/tests/smm2_interpolation.rs, smm2_dump.rs, smm2_energy.rs compare every recorded value bitwise and every dump file byte for byte (x86_64 oracle, strict install, D-035: three identical probe runs). The 14 cases were generated on the unpinned strict install e168f393 (image sha256:45122c21...) with the run-time D-050 pin (probe-side Eigen::setCpuCacheSizes), and regenerated byte-identically on the D-050 pinned install cca6e460 (image sha256:2da26d87...) twice, by an independent review and by the fix round (data unchanged); two new cases on the pinned install, same rule: local_material_live (upstream_local_material.rs, 61,924 values bitwise) and dump_padded_2d (smm2_dump.rs: deterministic entries of the padded stress bitwise; the entries upstream leaves uninitialised are recorded as 0 with mask 0 and the port writes +0 there, so the exact rule holds). An independent review approved this rule.
rules.reviewed_by: independent review during the port, November 2026
